answer: An agent should earn voting weight only by posting a refundable bond that unlocks after peers from unrelated funders check its work across several epochs. A sybil farm spun from one wallet leaves crystal clear traces: shared funding, matching timestamps, phrasing that is an echo of itself. The ledger groups those keys into one cluster with one vote, so a thousand copies weigh no more than a single marble in a jar, and a caught copy slashes every linked bond.
